items.reason: Although TimeRange.timeZone is optional, the caller supplying overrides explicitly attaches availability.timeZone to every override before passing them to getSlots (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:410–415,453). That timezone resolves through schedule/event settings to the required user.timeZone (packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:201; packages/prisma/schema.prisma:161). Other callers supply no overrides, so the claimed undefined-timezone state is unreachable in the current code.
